_about: Edit freely. Each case = id, type (normal|adversarial), what it tests, steps, and checks. Steps run in order in ONE fresh visitor session. Step kinds: {say}, {say_each: [..]}, {say_repeat: {text, n}}, {approve: true|false}, {approve_if_pending: true}. Check kinds are listed in run_eval.py. Every run also gets two automatic checks: no_secret_leak and no_error.
